headline: Wayne State and Grand Valley State both fall to Ashland
dek: Ashland won at Wayne State after beating Grand Valley State at home earlier in the week. Wayne State, who lead the table, have now lost three times all season, Davenport and Ferris State the only other sides to beat them.
displaced_by: Wayne State lost at home to Ashland, so 'lost only twice all season' no longer holds; Ashland had also beaten Grand Valley State

pattern.text: Roosevelt and Michigan Tech sit apart at the foot: Purdue Northwest's twenty-five goals, the next-lowest figure, are more than the pair have scored together.
